what_was_attempted: Calculate how many hours Eliud Kipchoge would need to cover the Moon's minimum perigee distance at his marathon world-record pace, rounded to the nearest 1000 hours.
approach_taken: The agent searched Wikipedia for the Moon distance and Kipchoge's marathon record, then fetched the Moon article and used the perigee distance with the record time to compute the result. It committed to the rounded calculation without changing strategy.
